Message_body: <external_source>Dear Surojit Dutta, We are honoured to welcome Mr. Periasamy Kumaran (BTEE '90), IFS, High Commissioner of India to the United Kingdom, as the Chief Guest at the IITMAA UK Chapter Annual Meet in London on Sunday, 5 July 2026. 🗓️ Date: Sun, 5th July 🕓 Time: 12:00 PM 📍 Location: St Peter de Beauvoir Town, (The Hall & Cafe) Northchurch Terrace, London, N1 4DA 💷 Alumni: £35 | 🎓 Students: £20**Includes lunch. Email maha@iitmaa.org with your student ID for the student payment link. Register Now Catch up with fellow IITM alumni and hear the latest updates from IIT Madras and IITMAA. Enjoy a fun IITM quiz and games, take home exclusive IITM goodies, and network over a delicious lunch by The Mallu Barstud, featuring Southern Kerala-inspired cuisine packed with flavour and nostalgia. 🎥 Watch a special invitation from IITMAA President Sridhar Boovaraghavan (BTCE '91) and join us for an enjoyable afternoon with the IITM community in the UK. Spread the word and invite fellow IITM alumni! Sign up today, and let's make this alumni meet one to remember. We look forward to seeing you there!Warm regards, IITMAA Team 📅 Upcoming IITM Events Around the World Venue Guidelines & Parking No parking is available on-site. Limited on-street parking is available nearby. Please check local parking restrictions before parking. Paid parking is available adjacent to the venue. Smoking is strictly prohibited within the venue premises. Please help us keep the venue clean and follow any instructions provided by the venue staff. Kindly be mindful of local residents when arriving and departing from the venue.
